boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, recreation, reflection, and student-led creative work.

cards.title: Memorial Arch
cards.subtitle: Campus landmark and Orientation walk site
cards.notes: Pause here on a campus walk, then look for Orientation programming that uses the Arch as a ceremonial starting point for new students.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing campus landmark tied to the new-student Orientation experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood identifies the Memorial Arch as a campus feature seen by students since 1915 and says new students make a ceremonial Orientation walk through it.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Library, academic support, and collaborative study hub
cards.notes: Bring your Marywood credentials, browse library resources, or coordinate a study session; reserve a group room when your group needs dedicated space.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building that combines the library, student-support services, and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes the Learning Commons as home to its library, academic-support services, career services, student services, and media studios; its library offers group study rooms.
cards.source_title: New Student Survival Guide | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are for current Marywood students; reservations and drop-ins are governed by library policy.

cards.title: Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Use this lounge for a low-key study break or conversation, and check the student-center calendar before relying on it during receptions or events.
cards.short_summary: A student-center lounge explicitly intended for relaxing, studying, and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood says the Fireplace Lounge in the Nazareth Student Center provides a place for students to relax, study, and socialize.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Nazareth Student Center; it may also host receptions and special events.

cards.title: Game Room
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Head to the open-floor-plan game room for a break between classes; ask Student Engagement about available games and any activity details.
cards.short_summary: A named student-center gaming room with university-described free leisure activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes the Game Room as an open-floor-plan gaming room in Nazareth Student Center offering free leisure activities.
cards.access_notes: Located in Nazareth Student Center; check campus access and event conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Esports Center
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Stop by to see the gaming setup or connect with the esports program; confirm availability before planning a session around the 30 stations.
cards.short_summary: A 2,000-square-foot gaming center with stations and a gaming lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood states that its Esports Center is in the Nazareth Student Center and includes 30 gaming stations, a gaming lounge, and related equipment.
cards.access_notes: Located within Nazareth Student Center; availability may depend on program and facility use.

cards.title: Center for Athletics and Wellness
cards.subtitle: Recreation and athletics complex
cards.notes: Check the current facility schedule before heading over, then choose the fitness center, track, climbing wall, aquatics area, or recreation spaces available to you.
cards.short_summary: An athletics complex with fitness, aquatics, climbing, track, arena, and lab spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood says the Center for Athletics and Wellness houses the Insalaco Arena, Aquatics Center, jogging track, fitness center, climbing wall, dance studio, labs, and locker rooms.
cards.source_title: Center for Athletics and Wellness | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Facility access and schedules may vary; follow posted rules and university recreation guidance.

cards.title: Swartz Center for Spiritual Life
cards.subtitle: Marian Chapel, Campus Ministry, and meeting spaces
cards.notes: Visit for a quiet reflective stop, Campus Ministry support, or a scheduled gathering; confirm room use before arriving for a meeting or celebration.
cards.short_summary: A campus spiritual-life and gathering building that includes the Marian Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood states that the Swartz Center houses the Marian Chapel, Campus Ministry offices, and Conference Center, with meeting rooms used for gatherings and events.
cards.source_title: Swartz Center for Spiritual Life | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Conference rooms may be scheduled for campus or public use; respect active services and events.

cards.title: Marian Chapel
cards.subtitle: Inside the Swartz Center for Spiritual Life
cards.notes: Check the current worship schedule before attending, or use the chapel respectfully during permitted open times for reflection and campus liturgy.
cards.short_summary: A chapel where Marywood holds regular worship services during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists Sunday Mass at the Marian Chapel in the Swartz Center during fall and spring semesters and says it is open to students, faculty, staff, and the public.
cards.access_notes: Sunday Mass is listed for 7:30 p.m. during fall and spring semesters; check with Campus Ministry when classes are not in session.

cards.title: Black Box Theatre
cards.subtitle: Terrace level, Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts
cards.notes: Watch for student-directed production announcements and attend a scheduled event; this flexible theatre is intended to support experimental work and performances.
cards.short_summary: A flexible laboratory theatre for student-directed and experimental productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes the Black Box Theatre as a terrace-level laboratory theatre with flexible staging for student-directed productions and experimental theatre.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts; attend during scheduled programming.

cards.entity_name: Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts
cards.title: Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: Munley Theatre, Black Box Theatre, and practice spaces
cards.notes: Check the arts calendar for a main-stage or Black Box performance, and remember that classrooms and private practice rooms support student academic work.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts center that hosts ensembles and performances throughout the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood says the Sette LaVerghetta Center hosts performances by Music, Theatre, and Dance ensembles and includes classrooms and private practice rooms for students.
cards.source_title: Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Performance attendance and access to instructional spaces depend on scheduled programming and university access rules.
